DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Tumor (Superior Sulcus Tumor) causing Pancoast syndrome.

The combination of progressive arm weakness, sensory loss, burning pain, significant weight loss, and your risk factors (smoking, age) strongly suggests a lung malignancy at the apex compressing the brachial plexus and subclavian vessels.
